title: Cloudways Review 2026: Plans, Pricing, AI Features and Black Friday Offer
excerpt: A Cloudways review from the host's own pages and one named independent test, with plan prices, the Black Friday offer and AI features.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Cloudways Review 2026: Pricing, AI Features, Offer
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Cloudways review for 2026: plan prices, the Black Friday 80% offer, a GTmetrix test from DevOpsCube, AI Copilot and AI Agents plans, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Cloudways is a good managed cloud host. DevOpsCube measured a GTmetrix grade of A. The Black Friday discount lasts only 2 months.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Cloudways good? | It is a good managed cloud host for people who want a cloud server without server work. DevOpsCube measured a GTmetrix grade of A on a WordPress test.
Is Cloudways good for WordPress? | DevOpsCube tested WordPress on a 2 GB DigitalOcean server and reported a GTmetrix grade of A with Core Web Vitals passed.
How much does Cloudways cost? | Flexible plans on DigitalOcean start at $14 a month at list price. Autonomous plans start at $99 a month. AI Agents plans start at $9.99 a month.
Does Cloudways have a free trial? | Yes. Cloudways lists a 5-day free trial on Flexible plans with no card needed, and a 3-day trial on Autonomous plans.
What is the Cloudways Black Friday offer? | 80% off for 2 months on all plans, with code BFCM802 shown on the pricing page. The page we read shows no end date.
Does Cloudways have AI features? | It lists Cloudways Copilot, AI Agents plans and an MCP integration. We did not test them.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Flexible plans start at $14 a month at list price, with a 5-day free trial.
DevOpsCube measured a GTmetrix grade of A, and edge caching made pages 66% faster.
The Black Friday offer is 80% off for 2 months, and the page shows no end date.
Cloudways lists Copilot and AI Agents plans. We did not test them.
meta.rl_g_glossary:
Managed cloud hosting | A cloud server that the host sets up and looks after.
MCP | A standard way for AI tools to connect to other software.
Edge caching | Storing copies of pages near visitors so they load faster.
GTmetrix | A tool that grades page speed.
